The '''Battle of Darga's palace''' occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] in [[Darga the Hutt's palace]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Background==
An [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team had came their to investigate [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]]'s connecting to the [[Sarlacc Project]] and were staying in the palace as guests. When they discovered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Denia]] imprisoned there, Darga's men turned on them, starting the battle.

==The battle==
In the resulting chaos, Darga fled his palace and left for [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and the team succeeded in escaping, along with Denia.
